title: Scratch: Loops & Conditions
welcome_lead: Make sprites repeat actions and react to what's happening.
meta_desc: KS3 Scratch: forever, repeat, if blocks, broadcast messages.
final_note: These three block types unlock games and animations.

concepts.def: A loop that runs without stopping.
A loop that runs a set number of times.
Block that runs code only when true.
Sends a message to all sprites.
Blocks that detect input or other sprites.
A diamond block that is true or false.

walkthroughs.body_html: Forever runs until you stop the script. Repeat 10 runs ten times. Use repeat when you know how many.
Drop a touching mouse pointer? sensing block into an if. Sprite reacts only when the condition is true.
One sprite can broadcast a message. Other sprites listen with when I receive. Great for game events like 'level complete'.
